purpose: Construct an absolute physical 3D stellar-plus-gas source, amplitude-multipole tensor coefficient, transport direction, and MOND boundary for spent RX J2129 without fitting or scoring a lensing outcome.

physical_map.normalization_mass: Mbar(<R)=gbar(R) R^2/G at the existing exact 200 kpc Tian anchor
physical_map.stellar_shape: background-subtracted nonnegative HST F160W with every known image masked and annularly filled
physical_map.gas_shape: sqrt(masked 0.7-2.0 keV Chandra rate times 2 sqrt(Rnorm^2-r^2)), zero outside Rnorm
physical_map.support: both components are zero outside the 200 kpc normalization aperture
physical_map.surface_to_volume: sech-squared with each component scale height equal to its projected RMS radius
physical_map.image_position_use: spent image coordinates are used only for the pre-existing HST contaminant mask; no residual, root, parity, multiplicity, critical curve, or topology score is computed

gravity.activation: sqrt(1-exp[-(D^2+Q^2)]) times the P0666 physical-length local activation
gravity.field_equation: div[mu(|grad Phi|/a0) (I-sigma h h) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_bar
gravity.boundary: simple-MOND monopole computed from the complete finite-grid baryonic mass
gravity.photon_closure_next_stage: zero slip: alpha_perp=-(2/c^2)(Dds/Ds) integral a_perp dz

selection_rule: Advance the single P0669 candidate to one frozen spent-cluster nonlinear scalar/tensor solve only if every physical-map, source-mass, activation, resolution, boundary, parameter, and no-lens-score gate passes.
claim_boundary: F160W light is not a resolved stellar-population mass likelihood; one shared 10 percent stellar baryon fraction is imposed rather than fit.
Chandra surface brightness is converted to a gas morphology using the same square-root emissivity/depth approximation used in P0641, not a native spectral deprojection.
The absolute mass is independent of lens residuals but comes from the same-system published radial baryonic reconstruction.
P0670 constructs inputs and coefficients only. It cannot establish lensing normalization, topology, or predictive accuracy.
RX J2129 is fully spent for later mechanism development; P0633 and P0640 remain sealed.
